on_findings.description: OnFindings: agent gives the findings to the next session, human opens the card with them, fail fails the task.

enabled.description: Enabled false skips the stage; the timeline records it skipped.

when.description: When limits the stage to some tasks: outsider runs it only on issues whose author is an outside account. Absent: every task.

items.description: Stage is one named stage of the workflow and what its findings do.

stages.description: Stages run in this order; policy, approval and merge are required, merge last.

title: factory/workflow
description: Workflow is workflow.yaml: the stages a task's work passes, in order (ruling 177).
